activity_log_set_before_start.name: activity_log_set_before_start
activity_log_set_before_start.value:
("activity_log"."action" = 'household.started') = ("activity_log"."set_before_start" is not null)
        and case
          when "activity_log"."set_before_start" is null then true
          when jsonb_typeof("activity_log"."set_before_start") <> 'object' then false
          else "activity_log"."set_before_start" ?& array['shares', 'daysAway']
            and not jsonb_path_exists("activity_log"."set_before_start", '$.keyvalue() ? ((@.key != "shares" && @.key != "daysAway")
  || @.value.type() != "array"
  || exists(@.value[*] ? (@.type() != "string"
    || !(@ like_regex "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))))')
        end

assignments_assigned.name: assignments_assigned
assignments_assigned.value:
("assignments"."member_id" is not null and "assignments"."cost" is not null and "assignments"."reason" is not null
          and "assignments"."unassigned_cause" is null)
        or ("assignments"."member_id" is null and "assignments"."cost" is null and "assignments"."reason" is null
          and "assignments"."unassigned_cause" is not null)

assignments_reason.name: assignments_reason
assignments_reason.value:
"assignments"."reason" in ('bound', 'assigned by head', 'linked', 'only eligible member',
        'lowest relative load', 'catching up')

assignments_unassigned_cause.name: assignments_unassigned_cause
assignments_unassigned_cause.value:
"assignments"."unassigned_cause" in ('nobody eligible', 'bound member not eligible',
        'linked member not eligible')

households_week_start_change.name: households_week_start_change
households_week_start_change.value:
("households"."week_start_change_from" is null and "households"."week_start_previous_day" is null)
        or ("households"."week_start_change_from" is not null and "households"."week_start_previous_day" is not null
          and "households"."week_start_previous_day" <> "households"."week_start_day"
          and extract(isodow from "households"."week_start_change_from") = "households"."week_start_previous_day")

occurrences_closed.name: occurrences_closed
occurrences_closed.value: "occurrences"."status" not in ('missed', 'away') or "occurrences"."closed_by_plan" is not null

schedules_rules.name: schedules_rules
schedules_rules.value:
jsonb_typeof("schedules"."rules") = 'array'
        and not jsonb_path_exists("schedules"."rules", '$[*] ? (
  @.type() != "object"
  || !exists(@.rrule ? (@.type() == "string" && @ != ""))
  || !exists(@.start ? (@ like_regex "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"))
  || (exists(@.season) && !(exists(@.season.from ? (@ like_regex "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"))
    && exists(@.season.to ? (@ like_regex "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"))))
)')

tasks_window.name: tasks_window
tasks_window.value:
("tasks"."timing" = 'fixed') = ("tasks"."window_from_day" is not null and "tasks"."window_from_time" is not null
          and "tasks"."window_to_day" is not null and "tasks"."window_to_time" is not null)
        and ("tasks"."window_from_day" is null or "tasks"."window_from_day" between -3 and 3)
        and ("tasks"."window_to_day" is null or "tasks"."window_to_day" between -3 and 3)

tasks_recurrence.name: tasks_recurrence
tasks_recurrence.value:
("tasks"."schedule_id" is not null and "tasks"."every_count" is null and "tasks"."every_unit" is null
          and "tasks"."start" is null and "tasks"."once" is null)
        or ("tasks"."schedule_id" is null and "tasks"."timing" = 'flexible' and "tasks"."on_miss" = 'roll over'
          and "tasks"."once" is null
          and "tasks"."start" is not null and ("tasks"."every_unit" = 'days' and "tasks"."every_count" between 1 and 365
            or "tasks"."every_unit" = 'weeks' and "tasks"."every_count" between 1 and 52
            or "tasks"."every_unit" = 'months' and "tasks"."every_count" between 1 and 12))
        or ("tasks"."schedule_id" is null and "tasks"."every_count" is null and "tasks"."every_unit" is null
          and "tasks"."start" is null and "tasks"."timing" = 'flexible' and "tasks"."once" is not null
          and "tasks"."added_by" is not null)

tasks_one_off.name: tasks_one_off
tasks_one_off.value: "tasks"."once" is not null or ("tasks"."deadline" is null and "tasks"."added_by" is null)

account_emails_recipient.name: account_emails_recipient
account_emails_recipient.value:
("auth"."account_emails"."kind" = 'sign-up' and "auth"."account_emails"."account_id" is null and "auth"."account_emails"."email" is not null)
        or ("auth"."account_emails"."kind" <> 'sign-up' and "auth"."account_emails"."account_id" is not null and "auth"."account_emails"."email" is null)

accounts_terms.name: accounts_terms
accounts_terms.value:
("auth"."accounts"."terms_version" is null and "auth"."accounts"."terms_accepted_at" is null)
        or ("auth"."accounts"."terms_version" is not null and "auth"."accounts"."terms_accepted_at" is not null)
